title: Integration Hub page loads and renders the connector catalog without errors
preconditions: Logged in as a user with integration.read permission
expectedResult: The page loads without console errors, the sidebar category list renders with badge counts, and at least the built-in connector cards (Google Drive, GitHub, AWS, Okta, Jira) are visible.

title: A user without integration.read permission is blocked from /integrations by PermissionGate
description: integrations/layout.jsx wraps all child routes in PermissionGate permission="integration.read".
preconditions: A user role without the integration.read permission
steps: Log in as the restricted user
expectedResult: The user is blocked from viewing the integrations catalog (redirected or shown an access-denied state) rather than seeing a blank or partially-rendered page.

title: Clicking 'Connect' on an OAuth connector card successfully redirects to the provider's authorization screen
steps: On /integrations, click 'Connect' on any OAuth-based connector card (e.g. GitHub)
expectedResult: The browser navigates to the provider's real OAuth consent/authorization page with a valid client_id and redirect_uri, not an error page or broken link.

title: GET /connectors responds 200 with a valid JWT and INTEGRATION_HUB VIEW permission
steps: Call GET /connectors with a valid org-scoped JWT
expectedResult: Response is 200 with { success: true, data: [...] } and no 5xx error, confirming the connector service and its DB connection are healthy.

title: Selecting a sidebar category on the Integration Hub filters the visible connector cards without a full page reload
steps: On /integrations, click a category in the sidebar (e.g. 'Identity & IAM')
Observe the rendered cards and badge counts
expectedResult: Only connectors matching the selected category render; the badge count next to the selected category matches the number of cards shown; no page reload/navigation occurs.

title: Disconnecting a connected integration succeeds and the card reflects a disconnected state
steps: On /integrations, open the connected connector's menu and select 'Disconnect'
expectedResult: The API call succeeds (200), the card immediately updates to a disconnected/not-connected visual state, and no error toast appears.
